Hi Amanda — quick clarifications from security that will help Acme’s reviewers: 

1) Audit window: the Type II opinion covers 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31. If your contracting window requires coverage into late 2026, we can provide a bridge letter that attests operational controls remain in place from the audit end date until report delivery (template attached).

2) Evidence index: the CSV included maps our artifacts to SIG/CAIQ and common SOC 2 CC controls. Typical artifacts we expect procurement/auditors to request: system architecture diagram, change control records, access review sample, incident response summary, backup verification evidence, and a sample of retention policy documents. If you need specific artifact IDs for any control, reply with the control list and we’ll map items.

3) Redaction & PII guidance: we will redact customer-identifiable data from evidence exports. If Acme needs full, unredacted materials for an auditor, we can arrange a direct upload to their review environment under an NDA.

4) Contact for auditor confirmation: BrightAudit LLP, Attn: Jeremy Patel (jeremy.patel@brightaudit.com). Please let us know if procurement prefers we introduce your contracting officer to their team.

If it’s helpful, I can join a 15-minute call this week to run through the CSV and attach lists.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security and Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: bridge_letter_draft_template.docx
